question: Which challenge + funded approach gives the shortest expected time from buying the first challenge to receiving the first meaningful payout (at least 1% of the account), counting retries and funded accounts that breach before paying?
registration_note: Declared 2026-10-03 before any v6 simulation. Payout-eligibility rules: Breakout on-demand USDC (kraken.com/learn/breakout-vs-hyrotrader); HyroTrader on-demand with at most 5% of the balance per payout (same source; minimum funded days not stated, assumed 0); FTMO first reward after 14 days (assumed from prior FTMO terms, verify). Challenge approaches are the fastest v5 ones plus the cheapest; funded approaches are fixed a priori. Historical seen data, descriptive; both samples must agree.
meaningful_payout: withdraw as soon as eligible and profit >= 1% of the account; the account then continues from 1.0

funded_approaches.P4_sprint_then_protect: blend 1.5x with headroom scaling until the first payout, then 0.75x with headroom scaling
funded_approaches.P5_constant_vol_15: blend scaled to 15% annual vol (30-day trailing), cap 2x, headroom scaling

metrics.p_pay: probability a funded account pays >= 1% before breaching (within 365 days)
metrics.D_funded: mean days from funded to first payout or breach
metrics.expected_days_to_first_payout: (D_challenge / p_pass + D_funded) / p_pay  (renewal: each funded breach restarts with new challenges)
metrics.first_year_payouts: mean total payouts in the first 365 funded days (approach's own withdrawal policy)

choice_rule: per firm, the pair with the lowest worst-case (over samples) expected_days_to_first_payout among pairs whose funded 12-month survival >= 0.6 on both samples; BTC challenge approaches are reported but flagged (both samples share one BTC path)
